description: Ecoshape and public flood-defence partners provide a transect-level representation of DTM LiDAR, drone and dune-valley measurements at Hondsbossche Dunes. Different area types are also indicated in the native description. Coverage: 2015-05/2018-03. Access: public native metadata describes the identified resource. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Current file access and cost are unknown. Provider-specific reuse conditions have not been read where general terms apply. Caveats: Transect spacing, interpolation, field units and detailed class labels are unstated. The transect representation has a distinct source identity from the area compilation. Related resources are separately identified in the native collection. The native Hondsbossche collection identifies these dune systems as primary flood defence created with sand nourishment. Simulation use concerns their monitored geometry and morphological development.
